## What & why

Describe **what** you changed and **why** — not a list of files touched.

## How to test

Steps a reviewer can follow to verify the change locally.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`yarn test`)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Targeted the `Development` branch
- [ ] Followed [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
